intro: Very low prices, a tropical climate and a growing infrastructure for remote workers. A simple 90-day e-visa for Russian citizens.
climate: Tropical: in the south (Ho Chi Minh City) it is hot and humid year-round at +28°C. In the centre (Da Nang) there is a pronounced typhoon season from September to November.
mentality: A dynamic Asian culture with respect for elders and a strong work ethic. The attitude towards Russians is traditionally friendly due to historical ties.
language_note: Vietnamese is the official language — tonal and difficult for Russian speakers. English is found in the tourism and IT sectors.
visa_note: A 90-day e-visa. The DN business visa is issued via a company invitation, valid for up to 1 year with the option to extend.
